name: native-reader-feasibility
title: Native reader feasibility
description: Prove exact reference CFI/canonical interoperability, lossless native Flutter layout and 120 Hz page-turn engineering feasibility on the iPhone, with a time-boxed diagnostic presentation-evidence spike, before broad UI work.
creator: shiroha
notes: Planned 2026-10-22. User decisions: diagnostic-only native presentation hook allowed (time-boxed); local phases commit once each on ios-build/s2-reader-probe; no push without user confirmation. Codex (gpt-6.1-sol, high) did Phase 0 and A, then was paused during Phase B. Sonnet 5.5 (medium) implement/check agents in the Claude session did Phases B and C. The user asks to stop after each phase: Phase D starts only on the user's explicit instruction. Phase D was implemented by the Codex CLI (gpt-6.1-sol, high) and reviewed by trellis-check; Phase E starts only on the user's explicit instruction. Phase E was implemented by the Codex CLI (gpt-6.1-sol, high) and verified/reviewed by the Codex CLI (gpt-6-astra, high); Phase F starts only on the user's explicit instruction. Phase F (runbook, report, evidence, specs) is done; the device run waits for the user's push confirmation. First device run analysed; user stopped further instrumentation and recorded S4 conditional GO.

meta.phase_f_executor: Codex CLI gpt-6.1-sol (high) in parts F1 and F2; verification by Codex CLI gpt-6-astra (high); no Flutter gate or trellis-check review for this documentation-only phase by user decision
